response.text: Journal 1001 has the same amount as 1000 but a different SRC_REF (PAY-1), so it looks like a payment journal rather than a duplicate. The AP tie-out gave two mismatches: invoices 357 (journal 1597) and 605 (journal 2000). I have enough to submit the findings.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO" = h."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY h."JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT") <> SUM(l."CR_AMT")
findings.summary: Journal 1597 is out of balance: total debits 14689.28 vs total credits 14644.28 (difference 45.00). It is the journal that recorded AP invoice 357 (INV_AMT 14644.28), so the debit side carries an extra 45.00.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID" = h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."STAT_CD" = 'C' AND h."POST_DT" > COALESCE(p."CLOSE_DT", p."END_DT")
findings.summary: Journals 2468 (period 7, posted 20240826) and 2469 (period 5, posted 20240618) were posted after their period's close date (7 closed 20240805; 5 closed 20240605), so they were posted into closed periods.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."JRNL_NO", i."INV_AMT", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO" = i."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."JRNL_NO", i."INV_AMT" HAVING SUM(l."DR_AMT") IS DISTINCT FROM i."INV_AMT" AND SUM(l."CR_AMT") IS DISTINCT FROM i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: AP invoice 605 (INV_AMT 1950.77) is recorded in journal 2000, which has debits and credits of 1932.77 each. The journal amount differs from the invoice by 18.00.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."JRNL_NO", i."INV_AMT", h."SRC_CD", h."POST_DT" FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO" = i."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IS NULL OR h."SRC_CD" <> 'AP' OR i."INV_AMT" <> (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l."DR_AMT"),0) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO" = i."JRNL_NO")
findings.summary: AP invoice 357 (INV_AMT 14644.28) is recorded in journal 1597, whose debit total is 14689.28. The invoice ties to the credit side, but the journal's debit total does not match the invoice. This is the same journal as the unbalanced entry above.
